name: document-index-corpus
purpose: A structural stress-test corpus. Every document was chosen because it breaks a different assumption in the ingest pipeline, not for its subject matter. FINDINGS.md in the corpus folder records what it caught.
why_this_file_exists: The corpus is 175MB of binaries and stays out of git. Without this manifest the folder is unrecoverable and every measurement in FINDINGS.md becomes unreproducible. Checksums are the authority: a re-downloaded file that matches sha256 is the file the findings were measured against, whatever the URL did in the meantime.
licensing: Everything here is open access, public domain, or a licensed sample. Nothing was taken from behind a paywall. pml-book-frontmatter is CC-BY-NC-ND, the tightest term in the set - fine as a local fixture, not redistributable.

documents.source: The 9/11 Commission Report, US Government Publishing Office
documents.url_note: The PDF carries no readable identifier - its Info dictionary is compressed. Search govinfo.gov for the GPO edition and verify by sha256 before trusting a replacement.
documents.tests: 585 pages; 22 top-level embedded bookmarks composed with font-size tiers; the placeholder title 'Title (201-635.job)'

documents.url_note: LaTeX-produced, no embedded identifier. The book is author-distributed free from probml.github.io; confirm the edition by sha256, since the author revises it.
documents.tests: 860 pages with genuine roman-numeral page labels - the printed-page citation guarantee

documents.source: A history of the mental growth of mankind in ancient times (Hittell), Internet Archive
documents.url_evidence: Identifier read out of the PDF's own metadata (Creator: Digitized by the Internet Archive)
documents.tests: A 408-page scan carrying an OCR text layer, so it takes the fast path rather than the OCR one - and its near-continuum of font sizes made almost every line a heading
Word with actual heading styles and a generated contents page - 109 correctly nested outline nodes
Content controls / form fields, which wrap paragraphs in w:sdt
Insertions, deletions and reviewer comments - deleted strings must never reach the index
Merged cells and nested tables through gfmTable

decks_purpose: Formats no parser reads. These test scripts/convert-for-ingest.ps1 -- what survives the round trip into a PDF plus a speaker-notes file -- rather than any parser. Licences here include NC and ND terms: fine as local fixtures, not redistributable.

decks.source: Database of British and Irish Hills user survey 2018, from the DoBIH v18.4 source-file mirror
decks.tests: 51 slides of which 30 are chart-led, plus 3 tables and no speaker notes: the deck genre the removed PPTX reader indexed as titles only. Converted, its chart categories, counts and percentages all come back as text
10MB legacy .ppt that is mostly photographs: tests the .ppt route and a deck whose bulk is imagery. Its slide titles are padded with spaces, which is what exposed the uncollapsed bookmark whitespace
Tiny 3-slide deck in Portuguese with a real embedded title, so it proves the placeholder rule does not over-reject a non-English one

decks.source: El primer militarismo y la confederacion Peru-Boliviana
decks.tests: One slide, and the Spanish placeholder title Presentacion de PowerPoint that the English-only rule used to accept
12MB image-heavy Spanish deck, second instance of the localised placeholder title
Modern conference deck with no embedded title at all, so the filename fallback is what must carry it
